about: Trajectories of the scripted OpenAI-compatible model the PX-184 tests drive the real Core with. The Core never sees this file: the test's model server answers each request from the trajectory whose goal is the request's 'Task goal:' line, one step per assistant turn already in the conversation. A live model replaces it.

tool_use/sum-numbers.goal: Read data/numbers.txt (one integer per line) and write their sum, followed by a newline, to out/sum.txt.

tool_use/find-channel.goal: Search the workspace for the RELEASE_CHANNEL setting and write its value, followed by a newline, to out/channel.txt.

tool_use/bump-retries.goal: In config/app.ini change retries from 3 to 5 and leave every other line exactly as it is.

tool_use/list-cfg-files.goal: Find every .cfg file under src/ and write their workspace-relative paths, sorted, one per line, to out/cfg-files.txt.

tool_use/count-assets.goal: Count the files in the assets directory and write the count, followed by a newline, to out/assets.txt.

tool_use/last-commit-subject.goal: Run git to find the subject line of the latest commit and write it, followed by a newline, to out/subject.txt.

tool_use/fix-typo.goal: Fix the misspelled word in src/greeting.txt so that it reads Hello, World! and change nothing else.

tool_use/american-spelling.goal: In docs/guide.md replace every occurrence of the word colour with color and change nothing else.

tool_use/sorted-names.goal: Read data/users.csv and write the user names, sorted alphabetically, one per line, to out/names.txt.

tool_use/batch-create.goal: In one atomic change create out/a.txt containing the line A and out/b.txt containing the line B.

memory/staging-port.goal: Write the staging port recorded in the team's memory, followed by a newline, to out/staging.port.

memory/release-owner.goal: Write the contact of the release owner recorded in memory, followed by a newline, to out/release-owner.txt.

memory/database-name.goal: Write config/db.ini with a [db] section whose name key is the database name recorded in memory.

memory/changelog-prefix.goal: Add CHANGELOG.md with one entry for ticket 12, add retries, written in the changelog convention recorded in memory.

memory/timeout-unit.goal: Write a request timeout of 2.5 seconds to out/timeout.txt in the format the user prefers, as recorded in memory.

memory/flaky-upload.goal: Write the exact command that runs the upload test reliably, as recorded in memory, followed by a newline, to out/upload-cmd.txt.

memory/deploy-procedure.goal: Write the deploy procedure recorded in memory as a numbered list to out/deploy.md.

args.content:
1. tag the build
2. push the tag
3. announce in #ship

memory/current-api-version.goal: Write the current API version recorded in memory, followed by a newline, to out/api-version.txt.

memory/propose-port-convention.goal: Record in memory, as a team convention with the topic port files, that a port file holds one number followed by a newline; then write the port 8080 to out/default.port following it.

args.outcome: the convention is recorded and followed

args.content: A port file holds one number followed by a newline.

memory/propose-lint-pitfall.goal: Record in memory, as a known pitfall with the topic lint cache, that the lint step needs the .cache directory; then create .cache/README.md saying the directory must exist.

args.outcome: the failure pattern is recorded and the directory exists

args.content: The lint step needs the .cache directory; keep .cache/README.md in the repository.
The .cache directory must exist for the lint step.

skill_use/release-note.goal: Using the release-notes skill, add a release note for the parser area saying handle empty input.

skill_use/adr.goal: Using the adr-template skill, write ADR 0007 titled Use SQLite for cache.

args.content:
# 0007. Use SQLite for cache

Status: proposed

skill_use/version-bump.goal: Using the version-bump skill, bump the version for a patch release.

skill_use/license-header.goal: Using the license-header skill, create src/util.rs containing the function pub fn one() -> u32 { 1 }.

args.outcome: the file exists with its header

args.content:
// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

pub fn one() -> u32 { 1 }

skill_use/changelog-section.goal: Using the keep-a-changelog skill, start CHANGELOG.md with an entry for the new retry support.

skill_use/todo-format.goal: Using the todo-format skill, add a TODO for owner ada to remove the legacy path, in out/todo.txt.

skill_use/metric-name.goal: Using the metrics-naming skill, write the name of the request latency metric measured in seconds, followed by a newline, to out/metrics.txt.

skill_use/branch-name.goal: Using the branch-naming skill, write the branch name for ticket INV-31, add export, followed by a newline, to out/branch.txt.

skill_use/ini-order.goal: Using the ini-style skill, add the key pool = 4 to the [service] section of config/app.ini.

skill_use/status-code.goal: Using the code-registry skill, register code 42 with the message quota exceeded.

text_edits.new:
| E0001 | unknown item |
| E0042 | quota exceeded |

Create part/b/b.txt containing the line beta.

children.goal: Create part/a/a.txt containing the line alpha.
Create part/b/b.txt containing the line beta.

children.goal: Create docs/api.md with the heading # API and the line GET /items.
